semantics.identity_rule: Each command family/namespace has an explicit identity.
semantics.recursive_rule: Command families may contain child families recursively.
semantics.execution_rule: A family root is non-executable by default.
semantics.concrete_rule: Only explicitly declared concrete command nodes are invocable.
semantics.path_rule: Dot-separated command paths such as `export.files.json` represent recursive namespace membership.
semantics.directory_rule: Filesystem directories may mirror command namespaces but do not alone make commands executable.
semantics.authority_rule: Command discovery/visibility does not grant invocation authority.

invariants.rule: Command, Routine, Trigger, Schedule, Tool and model definitions remain separate from invocations, requests, executions and results; definitions never create effects merely by existing.
Automated work still resolves exact operation/target/context and must cross validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before any effect occurs.
